description:
Execute an Overpass QL query to find POIs, roads, or other OSM features within an admin boundary area, bounding box, or radius. The server wraps your query in spatial filters and returns structured JSON with distance calculations and a map link.

SEARCH MODES:
- Location / Admin Area: when 'location' resolves to an OSM boundary polygon (e.g. 'Manhattan', 'Seattle'), searches inside exact boundary polygon.
- Bounding box (default): searches a rectangular area.
- Circle: searches within an exact radius when 'radius_meters' is provided.

COMMON TAG EXAMPLES:
- Restaurants: `nwr["amenity"="restaurant"]`
- Pizza: `nwr["amenity"="fast_food"]["cuisine"="pizza"]`
- Supermarkets: `nwr["shop"="supermarket"]`
- Parks: `nwr["leisure"="park"]`
- Hospitals: `nwr["amenity"="hospital"]`
- EV Charging: `nwr["amenity"="charging_station"]`
- Gyms: `nwr["leisure"="fitness_centre"]`
- Banks: `nwr["amenity"="bank"]`

bbox.description: The geometry to parse. Can be a raw bounding box string ('lat1,lng1,lat2,lng2'), WKT, GeoJSON, or ogrinfo extent. Either 'location' or 'bbox' MUST be provided.

limit.description: Maximum number of elements to return per page. Default is 100.

location.description: A text location to search for (e.g. 'Manhattan', 'San Francisco'). Either 'location' or 'bbox' MUST be provided.

offset.description: Pagination offset for retrieving subsequent pages of results. Default is 0.

query.description: The Overpass QL core query. Example: `node["amenity"="cafe"]` or `nwr["leisure"="park"]`. Multi-statement queries supported (e.g. `nwr["office"="coworking"]; nwr["amenity"="coworking_space"]`). DO NOT include spatial filters or output directives.

radius_meters.description: Search radius in metres. Enables circle mode — use ONLY when explicit distance is specified ('2km' → 2000).

return_geometry.description: If true, returns full geometry (polygon/polyline) for ways and relations instead of center point. Defaults to false.

sort_by_distance.description: If true, sorts returned elements by distance from origin/center. Enabled by default for circle mode and point locations.

timeout_seconds.description: Overpass server query timeout in seconds. Default is 25.

use_area_boundary.description: If true (default), uses exact OSM administrative boundary polygon for named locations when available, avoiding bounding box collapse.

name: search_overpass
